sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior cross-owner comparison, cutoff directions, pre-cutoff complete-marking alternative without a docking date, metre QuantityValue constraints, and iceClass range constraint. Repair the conditional marking validation: in the post-2007 branch, gate the mark-to-certificate equality query on summerLoadLineFreshWaterDraught > upperIceWaterlineDraught; otherwise an extraneous mismatching mark incorrectly fails a ship for which marking is not required.
